integrity: A self-contained proof gives the all-size assertion; a dependency-free checker supplies finite corroboration rather than an infinite proof. The archived verification output belongs to the included checker.
scientific_limitations: For synchronous in-neighbor AND only, on a common hub shared by at least one directed two-cycle and at least one directed three-cycle. No claim for arbitrary strongly connected directed networks, missing petal types, larger cycles, or asynchronous dynamics. Generic two-fixed-point conclusion is already part of general Boolean-network theory; precise labelled first-hitting-time counts are the result. Primary-text and indexed-search limitations mean historical priority cannot be guaranteed. No independent validation has been performed.
title: A six-step hitting-time census for Boolean dynamics on mixed directed cycle bouquets
